name: Portuguese (Min)

children.name: Two ILAC courses with a significant Lusophone component
children.desc: Students must choose two (2) ILAC courses with a Lusophone component to fulfill this requirement with the approval of the DUS, including courses taken with Stanford ILAC faculty abroad.

children.name: Electives
children.desc:
Students should take additional 100- or 200- level courses in literature and culture to meet the minimum unit requirement.

• Language coursework. Up to 12 second-year or above Portuguese language units may count towards the degree, not including conversational, oral communication, business, or medical language courses.

• Independent Study. With the approval of the Director of Undergraduate Studies, Independent Study courses may count towards the degree.

• Bing Overseas Program. Up to 10 units of pre-approved BOSP coursework may contribute to the minor.

• Coursework outside the department. One approved 3-5 unit course (5 units maximum) from outside ILAC or the Language Center.

children.name: Remaining units: ILAC literature and culture courses (100-299)
Remaining units: second-year or higher Portuguese language (up to 12 units)
Remaining units: approved independent study, BOSP (up to 10 units) or one outside course (up to 5 units)
DUS approval that the two ILAC courses have a Lusophone component
At least six courses of 3 units or more

grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade.
policies: These 23 units may not be used toward any other major or minor.
reviewNotes: You take two ILAC courses with a significant Lusophone component; the audit checks that they are ILAC courses, and the Director of Undergraduate Studies' approval of their Lusophone content is checked by hand. The minor is at least six courses of 3 units or more and 23 units in all. The rest of the units come from ILAC literature and culture courses numbered 100-299 and up to 12 units of second-year or higher Portuguese language, all letter graded. Approved independent study, BOSP courses (up to 10 units) and one outside course (up to 5 units) are moved in by hand. The units cannot also count toward another major or minor, which you check yourself.
